method: first value day vs source floor
words: The 49 Financial producer (account_return_daily.py) derives history_scope per account: PARTIAL_HISTORY when the account's first value day is on or before the source floor (the earliest balance partition), FULL when it is after, and every row of a call with a durable inception and a floor carries history_scope_claim = inferred. A call without a floor keeps the old constant and writes no claim. The Cottonwood Black Diamond adapter derives the same scope from the floor-day partition, which its landing handler passes as FLOOR_DAY, and appends the claim as the last column after the source label. No schema constant, ARROW_SCHEMA, SCHEMA_WITH_SOURCE, contract column list or schema hash moved: the claim is an extra column outside the contract's optional columns. NOT PROVEN: neither producer ran against S3; no gold partition was rewritten; the Cottonwood landing refuses to overwrite a partition that already holds objects, so rebuilding landed days is a separate act; the Inflection adapters still write the constant.
